label: Снова
description: A 10-sentence usage card for снова (again, anew).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Repetition of an event. 'Снова' means again and modifies 'идёт', showing the rain has returned. It signals a fresh recurrence, a slightly more neutral and literary alternative to 'опять'.

Strategic focus: Repeated mistake. 'Снова' modifies 'забыл' to mark a recurrence of the same action. Placed before the verb, it stresses that this has happened before, here with a faint sigh of frustration.
Strategic focus: Renewed meeting. 'Снова' modifies 'встретились' to show the meeting happened once more. The adverb conveys a return to an earlier state, fitting for a reunion.
Strategic focus: Encouragement to retry. 'Снова' modifies the imperative 'попробуй', urging another attempt. Here it follows the verb for emphasis, a natural spot in spoken encouragement.
Strategic focus: Cyclical renewal. 'Снова' modifies 'оживает' to mark the return of life each spring. The adverb suits this poetic, recurring image and sits naturally before the verb.
Strategic focus: Repeated completed action. 'Снова' modifies the perfective 'прочитал' to mean the book was read once more. The adverb pairs cleanly with the past tense to show a second full reading.
Strategic focus: Recurring problem. 'Снова' modifies the negated 'не работает' to stress that the fault has come back. Placed before the negation, it underlines the repetition of the breakdown.
Strategic focus: Return to a former state. 'Снова' modifies 'улыбается' to show that the smiling has resumed after the illness. The adverb marks the comeback of a previous condition.
Strategic focus: Suggesting a repeat. 'Снова' modifies 'послушаем' inside a 'давай' proposal, suggesting another listen. The adverb sits before the verb, framing a friendly invitation to repeat.
Strategic focus: Repetition in a question. 'Снова' modifies 'спрашиваешь' to ask why the question is being repeated. With 'зачем' it carries a mild reproach about the recurrence.
